Help & Guidance

Probate Guardian

Select a section to see help information.

Tour Step

Probate Guardian

This app keeps nothing in this browser between visits — every case lives entirely in a .sav file you choose and control. Open one to continue where you left off, or start a brand-new case.

Choose How to Protect This Data

This case holds sensitive information (Social Security Numbers, financial records, case details) that will live in the .sav file you save. Pick how it should be protected. This choice applies to this case going forward and cannot be changed later without starting over.

Unlock Probate Guardian

Create New Form for Existing Ward

Creates a new form of a different inventory type, with data carried over from the one you pick below.

Load Ward Info

Carries the ward's name, case number, county, and guardian contact details from an existing case into this ward. This overwrites those fields on the current ward — everything else is left as-is.

Switch Ward

This ward is already active. Choose another one below:

Start New Year —

This saves the current year exactly as it stands (still editable anytime from "prior years") and opens a new blank year for this ward.

Prior Years —

Every year is fully editable. Opening one makes it the active year for this ward; the year you're leaving is saved exactly as you left it.

Delete This Year?

Add New Form

Carries over the ward's name, case number, county, and guardian contact details from an existing case, so you don't have to retype them. Signature dates are never carried over.

Simplified Annual Accounting — Eligibility

Under Fla. Stat. § 744.3679, the simplified form may only be used when all property of the estate is held in a designated depository under § 69.031, and the only transactions in that account are interest accrual, deposits from a settlement, or financial institution service charges. If either answer below is "No," a standard Annual Accounting will be created instead.
Carries over the ward's name, case number, and county from an existing Simplified Annual Plan, so you don't have to retype them.
